captions.detailed: A compact, dark gray cube-shaped all-in-one printer with a flatbed scanner lid on top. The front face features a recessed control panel with a rotating selector knob and three small push buttons, a flip-down output tray door, and a slide-out lower paper tray. The scanner lid tilts upward from a rear hinge, the lower tray slides out horizontally from the base, and the front door swings down on a bottom hinge to reveal the paper output slot.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a compact cube-shaped all-in-one printer. The printer must feature a flatbed scanner with a hinged lid on top, a front control panel with a rotating knob and three push buttons, a flip-down output door, and a slide-out lower paper tray, all with realistic joints and dark gray plastic materials.
captions.factory: The printer base is constructed from a hollowed-out box primitive with a recessed front pocket for the control panel. The scanner lid, output door, and lower tray are modeled as separate thin-walled box structures. Small cylinders are used for the selector knob and the rotational hinges, while small rectangular blocks form the three push buttons. Revolute joints are defined for the scanner lid and the front door, a prismatic joint is assigned to the lower tray, and a continuous rotational joint is set up for the control knob.
